label: monad-mainnet
_notes: The causal cutover (SPEC §7.4), applied to the live mainnet deployment by contracts/script/UpgradeCausal.s.sol.

Each listed market prices every auction at the first Chainlink observation made more than skewSec after its oldest waiting order: the observation time is the one inside the report the oracle quorum signed (startedAt), never the chain's clock.

feedMaxAgeSec: a base feed silent for longer than this counts as closed (DISCOVERY). quoteFeedMaxAgeSec: the AUSD/USD round in force may be at most this much older than the base observation, or the market halts. depegBps: AUSD further than this from $1 halts the market.
closedMult 255: the vaults stop quoting while a reference is closed (255 x the spread is far outside any band).

control: a WMON/AUSD market kept on the old rule on purpose (ChainlinkReference: the latest round, stamped with the clear's own time). It exists so the standing challenge has a baseline: the same bot, the same vault settings, only the rule differs.
